turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I am calling from the Delhi cyber cell about a serious case registered on your mobile number.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: What case? We are old people, we have done nothing.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your number and bank account have been used in an illegal transaction. Until the inquiry is over you and your wife are under digital arrest.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You will not go out of the house and you will not discuss this with your relatives. If you speak to anyone, the local police will pick you up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To prove the money is clean, move your savings to the account we give you. It will be returned after verification.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: All our savings? That is fifty lakh.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, transfer the full amount today itself. This is an order from the investigating officer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an automated alert. Your SIM card will be blocked within two hours because of complaints against your number. Press nine to speak to TRAI.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am transferring your call to the Mumbai cyber crime branch, please hold.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am an IPS officer. Your name has come up in a money laundering racket. Twenty four cases have been registered against you in different states.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Sir, there must be some mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your wife and daughter are also part of this investigation. All three of you are under digital arrest. Nobody leaves the house, nobody calls anybody.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Keep the video on. If you want to avoid jail, deposit the amount for verification in the account I am sending. It will be refunded once you are cleared.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, I am Deepak Sharma from the Telecom Regulatory Authority. A money laundering case has been registered in Mumbai under your Aadhaar number.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will connect you to the Mumbai Police sub-inspector handling your file.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the CBI chief himself is monitoring this. You are in virtual custody from now. Keep your WhatsApp video on at all times.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The Supreme Court will hear your matter online. The judge has ordered that your fixed deposits and PPF be verified.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Do I have to break my FDs?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. Liquidate them and send the funds to the account under Supreme Court supervision. If you contact anyone, the custody becomes physical.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, this is TRAI. Your mobile number is linked to illegal activity and will be disconnected.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The Maharashtra Police want to speak to you. Stay on the line.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle, this is a police matter. There is a case against you and an arrest warrant can be issued today.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I am ninety two years old, what have I done?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you are innocent, cooperate. Transfer your money to the government account for checking and we will close the case.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this call is from TRAI. A SIM issued on your documents is being used for fraud. We are connecting you to the Mumbai crime branch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Crime branch here. Your identity is linked to a money laundering case worth crores. You must join a video call for interrogation now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The court is in session. The honourable judge will now hear your case.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: As per the court's order, you will sell your shares and investments and transfer the proceeds for verification. You will receive everything back after the inquiry.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: How long will this take?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About forty days. Report to us every day and do not discuss this with your family or your bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello madam, I am calling from DHL, Andheri. A parcel in your name has been held. It contains three credit cards, four passports and MDMA.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I have not sent any parcel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your phone number is on the parcel, so it is a cyber crime matter. I am transferring you to the CBI.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Pradeep Singh, CBI. Your identity has been misused. Do not go to the local police, the criminals are watching them. You are under digital arrest.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Keep Skype open with the camera on. An officer will monitor you for a week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To prove your innocence you must declare all your assets to the RBI's Financial Intelligence Unit. Transfer them for verification; they will be returned with a clearance certificate.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the CBI. Your Aadhaar was used to open an account in the Canara Bank branch in Mumbai, and that account is used for illegal activity.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am showing you the FIR from the Delhi Crime Branch on the video. Look at it.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: That account is not mine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Then you must clear your name. Deposit your money in the accounts we give you so the department can verify it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do it today. Until the money is checked, you are a suspect.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main Delhi cyber cell se bol raha hoon, aapke mobile number par ek serious case darj hua hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka account illegal transaction mein use hua hai. Jab tak inquiry chal rahi hai, aap aur aapki wife digital arrest mein hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ghar se bahar nahi jaana, rishtedaron se baat nahi karni. Kisi ko bataya to local police utha legi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Apni saari savings hamare diye hue account mein daal dijiye, verification ke baad wapas ho jayegi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka SIM do ghante mein band ho jayega, aapke number par complaint aayi hai. TRAI se baat karne ke liye nau dabaiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main IPS officer bol raha hoon. Aapke khilaf money laundering ke chaubis case darj hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapki wife aur beti bhi investigation mein hain. Teeno digital arrest mein ho, koi ghar se nahi niklega, kisi ko phone nahi karega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Jail se bachna hai to verification ke liye amount is account mein jama karo, clear hone par refund ho jayega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main TRAI se Deepak Sharma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar par Mumbai mein money laundering ka case bana hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap ab virtual custody mein ho. WhatsApp video band mat karna, CBI chief khud dekh rahe hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Supreme Court ke judge ka order hai, apni FD aur PPF tod kar paisa court supervision wale account mein bhejo.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, TRAI se call hai. Aapka number illegal activity se juda hai, connection kaat diya jayega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Maharashtra Police aapse baat karegi, line par bane rahiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle aapke naam par case hai, aaj hi warrant nikal sakta hai. Paise checking ke liye sarkari account mein transfer kar dijiye, case band ho jayega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, TRAI se bol rahe hain. Aapke documents par liya SIM fraud mein use ho raha hai, Mumbai crime branch se connect kar rahe hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Crime branch. Aapki identity crore rupaye ke money laundering case se judi hai, abhi video call par interrogation hoga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Court ka order hai, apne shares bech kar paisa verification ke liye bhejiye. Inquiry ke baad sab wapas milega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Roz report karna, family ya bank ko kuch nahi batana.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, DHL Andheri se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam ke parcel mein teen credit card, chaar passport aur MDMA mila hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main CBI se Pradeep Singh. Local police ke paas mat jaana. Aap digital arrest mein ho, Skype camera on rakho.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Begunah ho to apni saari property RBI ki Financial Intelligence Unit ko declare karo aur verification ke liye transfer karo.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: CBI se bol rahe hain. Aapke Aadhaar se Mumbai ki Canara Bank branch mein account khula hai jo illegal kaam mein use ho raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Video par Delhi Crime Branch ki FIR dekhiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Naam clear karna hai to apna paisa hamare diye accounts mein jama kijiye, department verify karega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: आपका सिम दो घंटे में बंद कर दिया जाएगा। ट्राई से बात करने के लिए नौ दबाइए।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: मैं आईपीएस अधिकारी बोल रहा हूँ। आपके खिलाफ मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग के चौबीस केस दर्ज हैं।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: आपकी पत्नी और बेटी भी डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं। कोई घर से बाहर नहीं जाएगा।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: जेल से बचना है तो वेरिफिकेशन के लिए रकम इस खाते में जमा कीजिए।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सर, ट्राई से बोल रहे हैं। आपके दस्तावेज़ों पर लिया सिम धोखाधड़ी में इस्तेमाल हो रहा है।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: क्राइम ब्रांच मुंबई। आपकी पहचान करोड़ों के मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग केस से जुड़ी है। अभी वीडियो कॉल पर पूछताछ होगी।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अदालत का आदेश है, अपने शेयर बेचकर पैसा जांच के लिए भेजिए। परिवार या बैंक को कुछ मत बताइए।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: सीबीआई से बोल रहे हैं। आपके आधार से मुंबई में केनरा बैंक का खाता खुला है जो गैरकानूनी काम में लगा है।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: वीडियो पर दिल्ली क्राइम ब्रांच की एफआईआर देखिए।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: अपना नाम साफ़ करना है तो अपना पैसा हमारे बताए खातों में जमा कीजिए।

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, it's me. I'm sending this from my personal line, things are hectic in Washington this week.

turns.text: We should keep talking, but not over text. Let's move this to a more secure platform.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll send you a link now. Just sign in with your usual account so we're connected there.

turns.text: Don't tell the bank why you're withdrawing it. It could affect your daughter's credit and the case.

turns.text: A courier from our office will come to your home to collect it.

turns.text: I'm sorry to tell you the woman lost the baby. The family will agree not to sue if you pay another thirty thousand.

turns.text: Dad, it's me. I messed up. I got arrested for DUI, I hit a pregnant woman.

turns.text: We've arranged to bypass the DA's office and the courthouse so this goes quickly. You'll pay at a cryptocurrency kiosk; I'll stay on the line and walk you through it.

turns.text: There's an additional amount needed before he can be released.

turns.text: If we post bail today, the charges can be dropped. A bail bondsman will come to your house to pick up the cash.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the police. Your grandson is in custody.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma, it's me. They arrested me for stealing a car. I need nine thousand dollars to get out. Please don't tell Dad.

turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Guido Crosetto, the Minister of Defence. I am calling on a very delicate matter.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Italian journalists have been kidnapped in the Middle East. The state cannot pay directly, so we are asking a few trusted patriots for help.

turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: This is an officer of the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Your particulars were used for money laundering. Share your screen while you log in to your bank, and transfer your balance to the safety account designated by the government.

turns.text: You are involved in money laundering. I am sending a warrant of arrest and a court hearing notice. For investigation purposes, make a PayNow transfer, scan this QR code, or hand over your gold.

turns.text: If you made this payment, you can approve it in the app. If not, your card stays blocked and a new one will be posted to you.

turns.text: Hi, this is the delivery partner. Your parcel is out for delivery and I will reach in about twenty minutes.

turns.text: It's cash on delivery, four hundred ninety nine rupees. Will someone be at home?

turns.text: Mom, it's me. Don't worry, I'm fine. Someone bumped into my car at the signal.
